topic: RIMAN Black Friday bundles are live: 3-question cheat sheet
text:
RIMAN's Black Friday holiday bundles are live. Six bundles, up to 57% in free value, until Fri Nov 27, 11:59 PM PT.

My 3-question cheat sheet:
1. For you, or a gift?
2. Starting fresh, or restocking?
3. Is your skin tight by noon?

Reply with your answers and I'll point you to one.
picture_tip: Your real RIMAN boxes stacked with a gift bag and tissue beside them on the kitchen table, daylight from the window, a sticky note reading 'Ends Fri 11:59 PM'. Square or 4:5.
video_tip: 8-10s: hands set down three products one at a time while on-screen text shows 1 / 2 / 3 from the cheat sheet; end on the gift bag. No talking needed.

topic: Myth-bust: your cream isn't failing, the order might be
text:
Your cream isn't failing this winter. The order might be.

What I do after 40:
Booster. Wait.
Serum. Let it absorb.
Booster again.
Cream to seal it in.

Dry skin first, one layer at a time.

Save this for tonight. I use RIMAN Dermatology Cream for that last step.
picture_tip: Booster EX, Serum EX, Booster EX again and Dermatology Cream with its spatula lined up left to right on the bathroom counter, soft lamp light.
video_tip: 12-15s at the bathroom mirror: pat face dry with a cloth, spray Booster and wait (text 'Wait'), massage in Serum, spray Booster again, spatula of Cream massaged in. Text on each step.

topic: Trail Bay Friday = last day of the bundles
text:
Black Friday plans on the Coast?

I'll be at Trail Bay Centre in Sechelt on Fri Nov 27, 11 to 4. It's the last day of RIMAN's holiday bundles.

Try a sample on your hand and guess the candies in the tub to win a Multi Stick Balm, a facial, or both.

Back again Sun Nov 29.
picture_tip: You holding the candy tub next to your Trail Bay poster at home, natural light, big smile.
video_tip: 6-8s: shake the candy tub at the camera, text 'How many? Trail Bay, Fri Nov 27, 11-4', end on the Multi Stick Balm in your palm.
